# Quick-Start Guides

## Quick Guide – Scoutlink IRC (Text Chat)



## Before JOTI weekend

  * Read BSA [CyberChip](/training/youth-protection/cyber-chip/) Guidelines for scouts using the internet
  * Register your group for JOTI here: <https://jotajoti.info/>
  * Learn more about [JOTI](https://www.jotajoti.info/about)
  * Explore normal IRC “texting” on ScoutLink using [webchat](https://webchat.scoutlink.net/)



## During JOTI weekend

  * Require scouts to follow the BSA CyberChip [“Cyber Safety”](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/youthprotection/pdf/100-055_WB.pdf) rules _(Recommended)_
  * Use [webchat](https://webchat.scoutlink.net/) for quick easy access to ScoutLink IRC
  * Monitor your scouts activity on ScoutLink IRC
  * Make a log of your units activities



## More Information

  * [WOSM JOTI Site](http://jotajoti.info)
  * [ScoutLink IRC Site](https://www.scoutlink.net)
  * [BSA Cyberchip “Cyber Safety” rules](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/youthprotection/pdf/100-055_WB.pdf)



## Additional Quickstart Guides when using IRC client apps

  * Quickstart Guide for Firefox: [Chatzilla](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/QuickStartGuide-Firefox-Chatzilla.pdf)
  * Quickstart Guide for IOS devices: [Colloquy](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/QuickStartGuide-Colloquy-IOS.pdf)
  * Quickstart Guide for Windows: [mIRC](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/QuickStartGuide-mIRC-Windows.pdf)
